top_signals.title: China’s Oil Imports Set to Rebound as Refiners Hunt for New Supply
top_signals.summary: Crude oil imports into China are set to rise by about 1.2 million barrels per day in the final quarter of the year from the current one, although they will likely remain lower than pre-war levels, Bloomberg has reported, citing energy consultancies. Oil purchases by Chinese refiners are climbing back towards 10 million barrels daily but may not hit that number until the end of the year, according to analysts from Rystad Energy, Energy Aspects, and FGE NexantECA. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $608M as Ether ETFs see largest inflow since October
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin ETF inflows pushed August’s total to a 2026 high of $2.07 billion as Bitcoin traded above $75,000 and Ether climbed to $2,357.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Euro Could Go Lower From Here, Yu Says
top_signals.summary: Geoffrey Yu, BNY senior market strategist, says he expects the momentum for European equities to continue from here, but he says the Euro could go lower. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
